title: DFLocalHealthStatus
description: Coarse health and operational status for a DF Local Foundation instance. This is the maximum visibility surface for control-plane consumers. No customer or domain data may appear here.

status.description: Coarse lifecycle state. Must not be 'ready' while any migration is pending or any error is unresolved.

expected_schema_version.description: Expected migration version per app/foundation declaration.

migration_required.description: True if schema_version is behind expected_schema_version.

last_error_class.description: Error category. No free-form text, no stack traces, no content fragments.

started_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this lifecycle instance was started.

app_mode.description: Operating mode of the registered app.

backup_available.description: Optional. True if a recent backup is available. No content exposed.

last_backup_at.description: Optional. Timestamp of last successful backup. Null if none.

export_available.description: Optional. True if export tooling is available.
